headline: Shazeer quits Google for OpenAI; China plans huge AI build-out
body: Talent and money concentrated further. Transformer co-author Noam Shazeer left Google for OpenAI, with more DeepMind researchers reported to follow, and Alphabet shares fell sharply. A lower-credibility report said Beijing has a roughly $295 billion five-year plan for national AI data centers built mostly on domestic technology. Both raise Power Concentration, and the China plan also adds to Capability Velocity, so Enslaved God and Zookeeper rose while Libertarian Utopia fell. A lab result showing printed artificial neurons talking to living brain tissue nudged Human-AI Merging, the factor behind Descendants. Horizon Balance dipped to +2.19.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.3, from China's AI infrastructure plan (+0.22) and Shazeer's move to OpenAI (+0.14), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04). Zookeeper +0.2, from China's AI infrastructure plan (+0.17) and Shazeer's move to OpenAI (+0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Libertarian Utopia -0.2, from Shazeer's move to OpenAI (-0.14) and China's AI infrastructure plan (-0.07), partly offset by Northwestern's printed neurons (+0.03).
